Source cards and pins transcribed individually; BH and BR use the upper B13 gate-control pin and lower unlabelled ART-derived input. BE/BN upper ART outputs loop to those lower pins. AJ/AX lower loops travel at rows56/57, independently visible in the source. Source controls move to rows47/48/52/54/55, and printed external references retain native BA rather than the prior sheet BB. All source arrows, wedges, basic crossings and one-cell diamond joins preserved. Native header losses and damaged BK4 board glyph use replacement characters.
